18: #pragma once

20: #include "BLETypes.hpp"
21: 
22: class NimBLEClient;
23: 
24: /**
25:  * @brief Characteristic subscription specification for Central role connections.
26:  */
27: struct BLESubscriptionSpec {
28:     uint16_t serviceUuid16 = 0;     ///< 16-bit Service UUID (e.g. 0x180D)
29:     uint16_t charUuid16    = 0;     ///< 16-bit Characteristic UUID (e.g. 0x2A37 for HR Measurement)
30:     bool     indicate      = false; ///< false = notify, true = indicate
31:     bool     required      = false; ///< If true and missing, connection is treated as failed
32: };
33: 
34: /**
35:  * @brief Inbound notification payload copied for safe main-loop delivery.
36:  */
37: struct BLENotification {
38:     uint16_t serviceUuid16 = 0;
39:     uint16_t charUuid16    = 0;
40:     uint8_t  data[64]      = {};   ///< Truncated to 64 B; truncated flags when shortened
41:     uint8_t  length        = 0;
42:     bool     truncated     = false;
43:     uint32_t receivedAtMs  = 0;    ///< millis() when host task received it (latency metric)
44: };
45: 
46: /**
47:  * @brief Extension point for modules that connect to external BLE devices (Central role).
48:  *
49:  * BLEManager manages: scanning, device selection, stored identity, bonding,
50:  * reconnection, GATT service discovery, and subscriptions. The provider declares
51:  * WHAT it requires and receives data on the main loop. It never sees NimBLEClient
52:  * unless it opts into onClientReadyWorker().
53:  */
54: class IBLEClientProvider {
55: public:
56:     virtual ~IBLEClientProvider() = default;
57: 
58:     /**
59:      * @brief Stable identifier; also the key for stored device identity (static lifetime, <= 23 chars).
60:      * @return Null-terminated string literal.
61:      */
62:     virtual const char* getProviderId() const = 0;
63: 
64:     /**
65:      * @brief Human-readable device category label for the web portal (e.g. "Heart Rate Monitor").
66:      * @return Null-terminated string literal.
67:      */
68:     virtual const char* getDeviceTypeLabel() const = 0;
69: 
70:     /**
71:      * @brief Service UUIDs used to filter discovery scan results (any match offers the device).
72:      * @param out Destination buffer for 16-bit UUIDs.
73:      * @param max Maximum number of UUIDs that fit in out.
74:      * @return Number of UUIDs written.
75:      */
76:     virtual size_t getTargetServiceUUIDs(uint16_t* out, size_t max) const = 0;
77: 
78:     /**
79:      * @brief Characteristics to subscribe to after connection and service discovery.
80:      * @param out Destination buffer for subscription specifications.
81:      * @param max Maximum number of specifications that fit in out.
82:      * @return Number of specifications written.
83:      */
84:     virtual size_t getSubscriptions(BLESubscriptionSpec* out, size_t max) const = 0;
85: 
86:     /**
87:      * @brief Optional extra filter for discovery scan results (e.g. name prefix).
88:      * Runs on the main loop.
89:      *
90:      * @param result Discovered peer scan result.
91:      * @return true to accept result into discovery list, false to filter out.
92:      */
93:     virtual bool acceptScanResult(const BLEScanResult& result) const {
94:         (void)result;
95:         return true;
96:     }
97: 
98:     /**
99:      * @brief Connected to peer; discovery and subscriptions complete.
100:      * Runs on the main loop from BLEManager::tick().
101:      *
102:      * @param device Persisted stored device identity.
103:      */
104:     virtual void onConnected(const BLEStoredDevice& device) = 0;
105: 
106:     /**
107:      * @brief Notification received from a subscribed characteristic.
108:      * Runs on the main loop from BLEManager::tick().
109:      *
110:      * @param notification Decoded notification payload.
111:      */
112:     virtual void onNotification(const BLENotification& notification) = 0;
113: 
114:     /**
115:      * @brief Connection lost or failed. BLEManager automatically schedules reconnection.
116:      * Runs on the main loop from BLEManager::tick().
117:      *
118:      * @param reason Disconnection reason.
119:      */
120:     virtual void onDisconnected(BLEDisconnectReason reason) = 0;
121: 
122:     /**
123:      * @brief User paired a new device (via web portal or MCP tool).
124:      * Runs on the main loop.
125:      *
126:      * @param device Stored device metadata.
127:      */
128:     virtual void onDevicePaired(const BLEStoredDevice& device) { (void)device; }
129: 
130:     /**
131:      * @brief User forgot the stored device (via web portal or MCP tool).
132:      * Runs on the main loop.
133:      */
134:     virtual void onDeviceForgotten() {}
135: 
136:     /**
137:      * @brief Opt-in worker hook executed on the BLEManager worker task after subscriptions succeed.
138:      *
139:      * Use for one-off blocking reads (e.g. Battery Level, Body Sensor Location).
140:      * Must not touch main-loop state without synchronization.
141:      *
142:      * @param client Active connected NimBLEClient instance.
143:      */
144:     virtual void onClientReadyWorker(NimBLEClient& client) { (void)client; }
145: };
